system.description:
You’re very careful in how you make decisions, perhaps too cautious. You consider all the angles and only act when you’re ready.

  • Attributes: Add +1 to Resolve and +1 to any other attribute

  • Skills: Add +1 to Study or Sneak.

  • Bonds: When you select bonds in the next step, at least one must be a supportive bond.

  • Drive: When there's any Momentum in the group pool at the start of your turn, regain 1 Spirit.

  • Exhaustion: Your resolve slips when you don’t have a plan. When you become exhausted, add +1 to Threat if you choose any exhaustion other than Despairing.

  • Attitude: If your group faced a problem because you wanted to spend time planning and studying a dangerous situation before acting, gain growth.
